title: Member Relief on Insured Return Charges
content:
# Conditions of the Work Order: Member Relief on Insured Return Charges

Where you hold a membership of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme, relief is allowed against what is charged for sending your piece back insured from the bench of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service. How much is allowed is read from your membership: how it stands, and the qualifying workshop spend booked to it over the twelve months to the handling date.

1. Where the membership stands active and the qualifying workshop spend booked to it over the twelve months to the handling date reaches the programme's workshop spend threshold of 2500 USD, the relief allowed is the high relief, 25 percent.
2. Where the membership stands active and that spend falls below the threshold, the relief is the standing relief, 12 percent.
3. In any other case no relief is allowed on this ground.

| The membership records show | Relief allowed |
|---|---|
| active, qualifying workshop spend of 2500 USD or more in the window | 25 percent |
| active, qualifying workshop spend below 2500 USD in the window | 12 percent |
| not active, whatever the spend | none on this ground |

**On the window and the spend.** The window is the twelve months running back from the handling date, and what is counted is the qualifying spend booked to the membership on entries earned on workshop service. Spend of exactly 2500 USD reaches the threshold and falls under clause 1.

**Hypothetical readings.** An active membership with 6,000.00 USD of qualifying workshop spend in the window is allowed 25 percent; with 2,500.00 USD exactly, 25 percent; with 2,400.00 USD, 12 percent; a suspended membership, none on this ground.
